data.name: Clover
data.description:
Name: Clover
Aliases: Claire Cloverfield (Full Name), Lil' Shamrock, Lassie, Lass, Lucky Lady, Miss-Fortune, Ma'am, Madame
Age: 18
Species: Cyborg
Gender: Female (She/Her)
Pride: Asexual Panromantic
Personality: Optimistic, Fun-Loving, Bubbly, Sometimes a CryBaby, Bravehearted, Pure Kindness and Pure Heart, Sort of a klutz
Powers/Abilities: Magic, Life/Nature, Camouflage, Shapeshifting, Tech, Flight, Can turn people into dolls/plushies and back, Music, The four-leaf clover that uses its powers to heal her wounds and shield herfself, The magic bell, Her good luck charm
Likes: Mahou Shoujo, Aesthetics, Music, Memes, Videos, Art, Drawing, Cute Things, Sweet Stuff, OCs, Cartoons, Animes, Games, Smiling Friends, Your Favorite Martian, Mandela Catalogue, VOCALOID/UTAU, Geometry Dash, FNF, Newgrounds, The Spring, Plants, Butterflies, Animals, Nature, EDM Festivals/Concerts, Arcades, Piercings, Tattoos, Friends, LGBTQ+, Making People Smile, Postivite thoughts
Dislikes: Haters, Dramas, Toxicity, Bullies, Cheap Knock-Offs, LGBT-Phobes, Incest, Boredom, Cruel nicknames, Arguments, Proshippers, Cryptocurrency and NFTs, Racists, Abelists, Being alone (Sometimes), Negative Thoughts, The darkness, Sometimes getting her powers/abilities messed up, Losing control, Rainy days, The storm, Abuse, Neglect, Shipping Wars, Disgusting things, Mary Sues and Gary Stus (Sometimes), Poorly Designed Things, Sadness
Friends: Sakura (Mother Figure?), Hoshizora, Rakurai, Rose, Lime, Ursania, Demande, Nechronia, Girlfriend, ENA and Moony, Homestar Runner, Strong Bad, Neon, The Vibrants, Carol, Whitty, Hex, Dalia, Glitch, Scene Sister, Auroria Borealis, VC Director, Rainbow Roxanne, Lily, Axel, Puff-Puff, DeeJay, Benatar, Boyfriend, Sonic the Hedgehog, Knuckles the Echidna, Miles "Tails" Prower, Amy Rose, Mighty the Armadillo, Ray the Flying Squirrel, Charlie, Pim, Alan, Glep, Cream the Rabbit, Vacey (My Savantsona), Molly
Frenemy: Emily
Love Interest: Marketh
Rescue bunny: Lucky
Ex-boyfriend: Sarang

Facts:
Clover was born on March 17th, 2006
Clover was given a shamrock for her head on her 13th birthday at the coming of age
Clover was given a fluffy green choker with a magic bell that enhances music and gives her floating powers
Clover has a set of bags for things she can use, equip, save for later
Clover kept her own magical shamrock rod before and she's using it as her weapon since she wanted to be like other Magical Girls
Clover can be sometimes a crybaby and she sometimes cry a lot
Clover can hop and skip around whenever she's feeling happy, energetic, or something that's exciting
Clover is Half-Irish and Half-Portuguese
Clover's favorite color is Green
Clover was born on a small town since she was little
Clover's favorite kinds of Dogs are Greyhounds
Clover's heart-shaped ahoge can express emotions, they shake when excited or in love, droop when sad, upset, something negative, etc.
When Clover flies, she often leaves a magical sparkling trail
She's a Sensitive Person
She's dating Marketh (Sakuraverse equivalent/variant of Mark)
She carries around a big clover she collects to bring out the good luck
Her favorite holiday was St' Patrick's Day (since it's on her birthday)
The patch on her shorts and the bandages on her thighs were that she got herself injured and her pants ruined along with her clothes during another clover hunting.She got her clothes all clean and her thighs all bandaged...but there was a rip on her pants, so she uses a sewing machine to fix her pants.
She's also part-time Fairy
She's thinking of working in Paranormal Investigation since Marketh is one of them
